name: github
description: Evidence-backed GitHub collaboration workflows for issue planning and publication, verified target branches, branches and worktrees, task-scoped autonomous commits and non-force pushes, controlled issue-linked draft pull requests, internal pull-request review-fix loops on existing head branches, CI wait, authorized required-check rerun, and bounded CI-fix loops, validated pull-request feedback integration, approved target refreshes and rebases with post-rebase validation, explicitly approved pull-request merges, verified post-merge and authorized triage issue closure, and separately authorized branch and worktree cleanup with current readiness, freshness, and strategy verification.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed GitHub issue, branch, worktree, commit, push, pull-request integration, issue-linkage, and draft pull-request workflows with task-scoped routine delivery, verification, and hard safety boundaries.
interface.longDescription: Read-only repository and issue analysis plus task-authorized GitHub delivery workflows. The plugin carries one verified task scope through issue publication and updates, branch and worktree preparation, exact commits, non-force pushes, issue linkage, draft pull requests, validated feedback follow-up, and an approved pull-request integration lifecycle with target refresh, rebase validation, merge, issue-closure verification, and separate cleanup decisions; it preserves explicit hard gates for force-pushes, rebases, merges, deletion, default-branch writes, and confidential data.
defaultPrompt: Load GitHub issue 123 from owner/repository into a complete LoadedIssue snapshot without changing it.

Address one verified pull request's open feedback through interactive triage, external implementation capabilities, current validation, evidence-backed thread replies, and eligible thread resolution without merging.
Detect this repository's development conventions for planning or implementation and distinguish mandatory rules from observed practices without changing it.
Derive a concise, evidence-based Git branch name from this task and repository conventions without creating or modifying branches.

Identify the applications, libraries, modules, files, APIs, tests, configuration, documentation, data models, and dependencies affected by this task from repository evidence without designing the solution.

Evaluate how this task could be implemented against repository architecture, conventions, and affected areas, compare meaningful approaches, and identify feasibility, risks, dependencies, and unresolved questions without changing it.

Resolve the relevant skills, rules, agents, tools, and domain capabilities for this issue and evaluated implementation, distinguish required from optional usage, report availability and gaps, and do not execute them.

Resolve the external skills and rules needed for these explicitly confirmed open pull-request feedback items across technology, architecture, testing, security, and documentation; report unavailable or missing capabilities without executing them or duplicating implementation knowledge.

Summarize this completed pull-request feedback follow-up as resolved, open, disputed, or blocked, link every solution to current evidence, list next steps, and report diagnostic merge impact without changing GitHub or Git.

Build a task-authorized implementation-ready plan from this issue, repository context, affected areas, implementation evaluation, resolved capabilities, and repository conventions without writing code or executing delivery.

Prepare this qualified GitHub issue by discussing material implementation alternatives and risks, carrying task-scoped routine authorization, creating and verifying its derived branch and worktree without implementing changes.
Analyze this loaded GitHub issue for evidence-based requirements, assumptions, gaps, blockers, contradictions, and implementation readiness without rewriting it.

Analyze this loaded parent GitHub issue from a product perspective into a ProductAssessment covering problem, outcome, actors, use cases, requirements, rules, constraints, acceptance, dependencies, priorities, and open questions without interviewing, creating sub-issues, or publishing.

Interview from this ProductAssessment into a ProductInterview covering missing or contradictory outcome, actors, user journeys, behavior, variants, business rules, edge cases, priorities, dependencies, constraints, and non-goals without creating sub-issues or publishing.

Map this parent LoadedIssue and confirmed ProductInterview into a hierarchical ProductCapabilityMap grouped by independently understandable Product Value and behavior areas, uniquely assign requirements, record overlaps and gaps, and do not create sub-issues or publish.

Decompose this parent LoadedIssue and ProductCapabilityMap into the smallest value-oriented ProductCapabilityDecomposition units, each with one observable outcome and independent acceptance, preserving parent-issue and parent-capability traceability, and do not create sub-issues or publish.

Assess each proposed sub-issue candidate from this ProductCapabilityDecomposition for atomicity across single outcome, scope, independent understandability, testability, domain behaviors, hidden requirements, and unnecessary coupling, classify each as too-large, atomic-enough, or over-fragmented, and do not create sub-issues or publish.

Analyze classified sub-issue candidates from this ProductCapabilityDecomposition and IssueAtomicityAssessment into a ProductDependencyGraph of evidenced product and mandatory technical blocks, requires, enables, related, and independent relations, detect cycles, question problematic cuts, identify parallel work, and do not rank slices by technical order, create sub-issues, or publish.

Prioritize classified sub-issue candidates from this ProductDependencyGraph together with the user using Product Value, user impact, urgency, risk, learning value, and dependencies, recommend must, should, could, and later without autonomously setting essential product priority, flag divergences between product class and required implementation order, and do not create sub-issues or publish.

Compose complete English standalone ProductSubIssueDrafts from this confirmed ProductCapabilityDecomposition and ProductIssuePrioritization, including parent reference, problem and outcome, scope, behavior, acceptance criteria, dependencies, priority, constraints, and capability and requirement traceability, without creating or publishing GitHub issues.

Analyze this GitHub pull-request diff across correctness, architecture, security, performance, maintainability, tests, documentation, and scope, return evidence-backed findings with separate uncertainties, and do not publish comments or change files.
Compare this original GitHub issue with its rewritten revision and produce an evidence-based semantic diff with scope-drift and contradiction flags without changing either source.
Assess this GitHub issue's completeness, understandability, implementability, testability, scope, and contradictions without changing it.
Split this large GitHub product issue into nearly atomic sub-issues that each have one independently understandable outcome, verifiable acceptance criteria, and distinct product value.
Interview me to decompose this product request into nearly atomic GitHub issues without inventing product decisions.
Define observable, testable acceptance criteria for this scoped requirement without changing the issue.
Structure the problem, affected users, current and desired behavior, scope, non-goals, dependencies, risks, and acceptance criteria into an IssueAssessment without publishing a rewrite.
Rewrite this issue into a structured implementation-ready specification and summarize significant changes without publishing it.

Start the thin implement-auto-issue workflow for this new request, create and refine the issue, prepare the workspace, implement through available session capabilities, and publish one Draft pull request without reviewing or merging.

Start the thin refine-auto-issue workflow for this existing GitHub issue, refine it, prepare the workspace, implement through available session capabilities, and publish one Draft pull request without creating a new issue, reviewing, or merging.

Start the thin auto-review-fix-pr workflow for this verified pull request, confirm mandatory diff findings and open feedback in a host-neutral ReviewFixPlan, fix them on the existing head branch, commit and non-force push, then repeat the re-review loop without publishing a review or merging.

Start the thin auto-ci-fix-pr workflow for this verified pull request, wait for required checks without treating pending as pass, rerun only exactly authorized required check names, confirm remaining failures in a host-neutral CiFixPlan, fix them on the existing head branch, commit and non-force push, then reassess checks without merging or marking Ready-for-Review.

Start the thin ready-pr workflow for this verified Draft pull request, require a unique linked issue, propose optional reviewers as suggestions, and mark it Ready-for-Review only after exact authorization of that pull request, head SHA, and reviewer set without reviewing or merging.

Start the thin plan-product workflow for this parent GitHub issue, turn it into a prioritized graph of nearly atomic product sub-issues through analysis, interview, capability mapping, decomposition, atomicity, dependencies, and prioritization, show the complete issue structure, order, parallel groups, priorities, and open decisions, and hand the approved set to create-product-sub-issues only after exact overall-plan approval.

Start the thin reprioritize-issues workflow for this repository, list currently open GitHub issues, rank them into unique consecutive P1 through Pn title prefixes with me, and apply those titles only after exact ranked-set approval without changing bodies, labels, or state.

Start the thin close-issue workflow for this verified GitHub issue, require an exact close reason of duplicate, not planned, or consciously not delivered, and close it only after exact authorization of that repository, issue, and reason without merging a pull request.
Load every currently open GitHub issue in this repository into an OpenIssueInventory excluding pull requests, preserve titles and parsed P-prefix evidence, and fail closed when the list is truncated.
Rank this OpenIssueInventory into unique consecutive P1 through Pn proposed titles without writing GitHub or treating a recommendation as confirmation.

Apply this confirmed OpenIssueRanking as unique P-number titles after exact-set authorization and a live identity check, delegate each title patch to update-github-issue, and continue remaining updates after a partial failure.

Publish this fully approved product plan as GitHub sub-issues from confirmed drafts only, create every issue before finalizing parent and hard-dependency relationships, and return the unit-id mapping plus failed operations.
Start the thin create-issue workflow for this new request, determine the repository, guide material clarification, and publish within the verified task scope.
Turn this new product request into a quality-checked, approved GitHub issue and publish it.
Start the thin refine-issue workflow for this existing issue, load and compare the revision, and overwrite it within the verified task scope.
Interview me to clarify and rewrite this GitHub issue.
Turn this vague issue into an actionable English specification.
Review this GitHub issue and identify the decisions needed before rewriting it.
Publish this approved issue draft as a new issue or an approved rewrite and verify the result.
Apply this approved partial update to the existing GitHub issue and verify the result.
Verify this existing worktree against its expected repository, branch, base revision, and safe starting state without repairing Git state.
Classify this inspected worktree's changes by purpose, component, and issue or ImplementationPlan relationship using diff and plan evidence without modifying or staging anything.

Detect changes unrelated to this issue or ImplementationPlan, distinguish necessary technical side effects from scope violations, and report evidence-backed blockers or clarification needs before commit or pull-request preparation without changing files.
Deliver this completed implementation through exact scope validation, an authorized commit, a verified non-force push, issue linkage, and a verified GitHub Draft pull request.

Merge this verified open pull request only after I give exact final approval and current MergeReadiness is ready; recheck its Draft state, reviews, required checks, conflicts, base branch, and the approved merge strategy immediately before merging, then verify the merge commit and final status.

Integrate this verified open pull request through blocker discussion, approved target-base refresh, separately approved rebase, conflict analysis, post-rebase validation, final readiness, separately approved merge, issue-closure verification, and independent branch and worktree cleanup decisions.

Validate this explicitly identified branch after a completed rebase by comparing its history and diff with the pre-rebase implementation and selected base, checking scope, current-head tests, and status checks without rebasing, pushing, or merging.
